en.quote: …ensure that by 2020 at least five Russian universities enter the world’s top 100.
en.head: One Russian university, rather than five, made an overall top 100.
en.body: Moscow State University ranked 84th in the 2020 QS World University Rankings and was the only Russian university in its overall top 100. No Project 5-100 participant entered the overall top 100 in QS, THE or ARWU by the end of 2020. The decree’s target applied to all Russian universities, so MSU counts: one rather than at least five. Subject rankings are excluded.
en.meta_context: Decree No. 599, “On Measures to Implement State Policy in Education and Science”
